strength.label: Strength
entropy.note: Entropy measures the random choices in a password. More bits mean more possible passwords for an attacker to try.
crack.label: Estimated time to crack: {time}
crack.note: This is an average estimate. It assumes an attacker who has the stored password data and makes 10 billion guesses per second.
strength.assumeWords: This estimate assumes that the attacker knows that Hekate uses random words from the {language} word list, and knows the selected options.
strength.assumeCharacters: This estimate assumes that the attacker knows that Hekate uses random characters, and knows the selected character sets and length.
strength.naive: Length-based comparison: {strength}, {entropy}, estimated time to crack {time}. This comparison ignores how Hekate made the password. It uses only the length and the character groups, such as lowercase letters or digits.
credits.title: Credits
error.insecure: This page is not secure. Hekate needs a secure page (HTTPS), so it makes no password.
error.unsupported: This browser does not have a feature that Hekate needs, so it makes no password.
error.noRandom: This browser cannot give secure random numbers, so Hekate makes no password.
error.wasm: Hekate could not load its password code, so it makes no password.
error.wordlist: Hekate could not load the word list, so it makes no password.
error.wordlistHash: The word list is not the file that Hekate expects, so it makes no password.
error.translation: The translation file is not the file that Hekate expects, so it makes no password.
error.noWordlists: This copy of Hekate has no word lists, so it makes no password.
error.generate: Hekate could not make a password.
